name: Tan Bo
bio: Tan Bo sells for Lim Seng aboard the Kim Hong. He answers a question about the cargo with a story about the packing, and wants his employer to hear his account before anyone else's.
notes: gameplay: Tan Bo is the factor on the Guangzhou junk carrying porcelain bowls and raw silk. He handles the suspect nutmeg jars; the jar marks, seals and manifest are inventions (data/inspections/case_001.json; docs/research/seals-marks-packaging.md)

gameplay: If the jars are held, Tan Bo can offer names at a later hearing in exchange for having his testimony heard by the temenggung. If cleared, he puts distance between himself and Hamzah before another transaction (data/inspections/case_001.json; data/events/ev_kim_hong_whispers.json; docs/gameplay-blueprint.md §09)
